name: VAULT OF AGES
description: We still don’t know who built it, or why it’s here. A monolith rising out of the desert — seamless alloy walls, resonating at 0.7 Hz. Comms die the moment you get within four hundred meters. We sent a drone inside. The feed lasted forty seconds. In that time, crystalline matrices projected fragments of history — civilizations, wars, faces of the fallen. Then something changed. The images shifted as the drone drew closer. Moments later, every system rebooted with one message: ACCESS TERMINATED. This place wasn’t meant to be found. And I think we’ve already seen too much.
